summary: Asobo Studio's medieval stealth/action-adventure series about Amicia and Hugo de Rune, tracking the original release, enhanced current-generation versions, and cloud ports.

entries.title: A Plague Tale: Innocence
entries.definitive_edition: Windows release, with PS5/Xbox Series enhanced versions as console alternatives

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release for best archive capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC output; console alternative offers official 4K/60 enhanced mode.

primary.version: A Plague Tale: Innocence PC release
primary.why: Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible capture route for the complete original game. The PS5 and Xbox Series X/S enhanced versions add 4K/60 features for consoles, while Switch is a cloud version and has no content advantage.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release natively with current PC settings; use the PS5/Xbox Series enhanced versions only if console capture is preferred.

entries.remaster_caveats: The current-generation console versions are enhanced ports, not content-expanded remasters; Switch is cloud-only.

entries.title: A Plague Tale: Requiem

primary.version: A Plague Tale: Requiem PC release
primary.why: Requiem released on current-generation consoles, Windows, and Switch Cloud. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most configurable route, while Switch is cloud-only and no platform-exclusive story content is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release natively through a legitimate PC storefront; use DLSS/FSR or display settings as appropriate for stable capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster is documented; Switch is cloud-only.
